21/S0.subgoal: Describe how AR tools will be classified based on programming skill requirements.

21/S1.subgoal: Explain the four categories of AR software tools based on required programming skill.

21/S2.subgoal: Give examples of software tools in each of the four AR categories.

21/S3.subgoal: Compare different methods for categorizing AR software tools.

21/S4.subgoal: Describe the functionality and limitations of low-level AR software libraries.

21/S5.subgoal: Explain how combining libraries into a framework using scene graphs improves AR development.

21/S6.subgoal: Illustrate the concepts of tracking and 3D registration using example AR frameworks.

21/S7.subgoal: Summarize the different ways various libraries support AR tracking.

21/S8.subgoal: Explain the need and benefits of using rapid prototyping tools for AR ideas.

21/S9.subgoal: Describe how Flash-based tools can be used to create quick AR prototypes.

21/S10.subgoal: Review the categories of AR software and preview the subsequent topics.
